scope: Historical event comparisons, not a capital-constrained portfolio. First calculation is the first chronological event and its first eligible asset, with BTC, under rule A only.
selection: Five historical eligible altcoins per signal, frozen across all entry rules; no selection by subsequent return.

entry_rules.A: Open of signal day + 1 calendar day.
entry_rules.B: Open of signal day + 7 calendar days, counted from the signal date rather than from entry A.
entry_rules.C: First BTC close with RSI >= 30 on days signal+1 through signal+30; entry at next daily open. No qualifying close means no trade, retained in the event summary.

exit_rule: Open exactly 90 calendar days after the actual entry date of each rule.
price_venue: BTC benchmark on the same venue as its paired altcoin; signal RSI always Binance BTC/USDT.
cost_basis: Scenario assumptions, not verified historical customer fee schedules or order-book estimates. No discount or rebate model.
cash_flow: Fixed quantity held between entry and exit; buy fee added to cash outlay, sell fee deducted from proceeds. Fees in USDT. A hypothetical initial budget is fully allocated including entry costs.
missing_data: No filling of non-traded prices and no replacement of historically selected coins. Missing entry/exit prices receive an explicit status, not a zero return.
reporting: Per coin, entry rule and holding period, with event counts and paired BTC. No summing overlapping trade returns as portfolio profit.
risk_definition_to_apply_later: Entry-relative adverse excursion from daily lows during entry day through day before exit; separately label any close-based peak-to-trough drawdown. Do not confuse the two.
time_stability_plan: Report 2020-2022 and 2023-2025 separately. If selecting a rule on the earlier period, train only on trades whose outcomes are observed before 2023-01-01 and assess later signals without re-tuning. Report exclusions and dependence; do not infer independence from sample size.
ranking_limitation: Earlier snapshot age is documented. Historical publication time remains an unverified availability assumption.
execution_limitation: Daily-open simulation with model costs; no proof of real fill, order-size liquidity, tick or lot rounding.
